description: The committed merchant-feed controls reproduced both expected outcomes, so the sample is ready for mission closure and the existing incoming-inquiry rehearsal. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, leaving demand unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. In parallel, test whether an NLnet open call can fund a concrete improvement to an existing open-source tool. A current call with compatible eligibility, deliverables and payment terms would justify a proposal for the authorized operator.
